from collections import defaultdict, deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        col=grid[r][c]
        if col==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while q:
          x,y=q.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
          for nx,ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
            if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and (nx,ny) not in seen and grid[nx][ny]==col:
              seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
        comps.append((col,comp))
    sizes=defaultdict(list)
    for col,co in comps: sizes[col].append(len(co))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for col,co in comps:
      if len(co)==1 and any(s>1 for s in sizes[col]):
        r,c=co[0];out[r][c]=0
    return out
